Title: Session .png screenshots leak on delete/prune
Reproduction: Run `screenshot` for a session then `stop --remove` or wait for TTL prune
Actual: Only .json and .log deleted; .png binary files accumulate forever
Fix: Added unlink of screenshot path in deleteSessionFiles (server/src/cli/session-files.ts)
Regression Test: session-files.test.ts: deletes the .png screenshot file too

Title: Focus can escape a modal when active element is outside the trap
Reproduction: Open modal; focus moves to an element outside (removed/disabled); press Tab
Expected: Focus is pulled back inside the trap
Actual: Tab only wrapped on first/last; if activeElement was outside the trap Tab left the modal
Root Cause: handleKeyDown only checked activeElement===first/last and ignored the escaped case
Fix: Added container.contains(activeElement) check to pull focus back (useFocusTrap.js)
Regression Test: useFocusTrap.test.jsx: pulls focus back inside when it has escaped

Title: Unsafe focus restore on unmount
Reproduction: Open modal while a trigger element is focused; remove that trigger; close modal
Actual: previouslyFocused.focus() called unconditionally; could target a detached node
Root Cause: Cleanup did not verify the node still exists/focusable
Fix: Guard with document.contains + typeof focus + try/catch (useFocusTrap.js)
Regression Test: useFocusTrap.test.jsx: does not throw when previously focused element removed

Title: Emergency compaction builds an invalid first message role
Reproduction: Trigger compaction then make normal summarization throw so emergencyCompact runs
Actual: Array started with role 'assistant', so the next API call would 400
Root Cause: emergencyCompact hardcoded a leading assistant message
Fix: Start with synthetic user message; add assistant turn only when recentContext[0] is user (conversation-compaction.js)
Regression Test: Covered by reasoning + existing suite (function not exported); no regression

Title: retryWithBackoff documented exponential but implemented linear
Reproduction: Call retryWithBackoff with delay=100 and observe waits
Root Cause: Backoff used delay*attempt instead of delay*2^(attempt-1)
Fix: Changed to delay*Math.pow(2 attempt-1) (retry.js); early retries unchanged
Regression Test: retry.test.js: waits with exponential backoff between attempts

Title: Step labels show raw 'Computer: <action>' for several real actions
Actual: Generic 'Computer: <action>' because mapping used nonexistent action names mouse_move/drag
Root Cause: getActionDescription action names did not match src/tools/definitions.js
Fix: Added correct branches + label map; refactored into describeComputerAction (format.js)
Regression Test: format.test.js: describes every real computer action with a friendly label

Title: String flag consumes following flag as its value
Expected: Reject or treat --json as a flag
Actual: url swallows --json; or undefined when flag is last
Fix: Fixing risks rejecting legitimate values starting with '-' (context/task); documented as known limitation

Title: DOM serializer can exceed maxChars by one element
Reproduction: Serialize a tree where a single late node is large
Actual: charCount checked after the line is pushed so one oversized line slips through
Fix: Deferred (efficiency only; truncation still functions; strict fix touches many push sites in hot path)

Title: Codex non-streaming tool_use loses id when only item.id present
Reproduction: Codex Responses API non-streaming output with function_call lacking call_id
Expected: tool_use.id falls back to item.id (as streaming path does)
Actual: tool_use.id set to undefined; breaks tool-result correlation
Fix: Added || item.id fallback to match streaming path (codex-provider.js:343)
Regression Test: Verified by code parity with streaming path (line 303); no unit harness for provider

Title: Element id with CSS-special chars throws in label lookup
Reproduction: Page has <input id='a\"b'> with a matching <label for>
Status: Selector built by raw string concat without CSS.escape
column12: Verified by reasoning + lint/build; content-script (no unit harness)

Title: npm run lint quality gate broken (88 errors)
Actual: 88 no-undef errors: describe/it/expect/vi undefined in committed *.test.js files
Root Cause: ESLint test override (.eslintrc.json) set env node but omitted vitest globals
Fix: Added vitest globals (describe/it/expect/vi/before*/after*) to the *.test.js override
Regression Test: `npm run lint` now exits 0 (4 pre-existing complexity/unused warnings remain in api.js/service-worker.js)
